'''Milac Troper''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Scout Corps]] around [[40 BBY/Legends|40 BBY]] before joining the [[Imperial Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Imperial Diplomatic Corps]]. During his career as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]], Troper and his partners, [[Mission Commander]] [[Dayla Kev]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Hereven]], traveled to an undiscovered jungle [[Planet/Legends|world]]. The scheduled trip proved to be a particularly dangerous mission.<ref name="GC6" />

After he and his comrades were attacked by a [[gasnit]], Troper fled in panic, fearing them to be [[Death/Legends|dead]]. He later reported the loss of Kev and Hereven and was temporarily suspended for his lack of valor. A failed rescue mission reported back on the ferocity of gasnits, however Kev and Hereven were presumed lost. Troper was reinstated and he eventually joined the Imperial Diplomatic Corps. Unbeknownst to Troper, however, both Kev and Hereven had indeed survived the attack of the gasnit, hiding out for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] in an underground cavern.<ref name="GC6" />

Years later, Troper was aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] ''[[Galactic Horizon]]'' to negotiate a peace treaty when to his surprise, he found that Dayla Kev had been plotting to exact revenge on him. However, he had hired a team of freelance [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to be his bodyguards, which saved him from her attacks. Troper tried to explain to her that he was haunted by his cowardice but she refused to believe him. However, Troper managed to escape unharmed while Dayla and her son, also named Hereven, were taken into custody.<ref name="GC6" />
